title: `merge --lane-lint` refuses a PR that deletes a debt file whose Retire line names no tracked test file
why: Incident: PR #2796, run 43258323745. Batch 133's passing 41-minute run was thrown away at the merge, because a debt-only PR runs only the `touched` job, which selects no test, so the PR could prove nothing (decision debt-close-runs-retire). Grant: owner 11:36 CST Nov 13 via runner 10 (R67 express). Rewritten from the lane's message.
note: Task: `merge --lane-lint` refuses a PR that deletes (or renames out of docs/debts/) a debt file whose Retire line names no tracked test file in backticks. A `Retire-run:` cite does not clear it. Build: a new function in lint/check_debt_retire.py, reusing its close and Retire readers; lane_lint in merge/merge.py adds its findings to the fails list. The remedy tells the lane to name the test file in the Retire line, and to touch it or pin it so `touched` runs it. The lane also checks whether `touched` (.github/scripts/touched-tests.py) can select the Retire-named test and reports. Done check: new red-then-green cases in lint/test_check_debt_retire.py and merge/test_lane_lint.py; `merge --lane-lint` passes on the PR; the draft's lane-touched-tests run is green on Windows and macOS at its head. Check change: Sonnet round 1. Status 11:40 CST Nov 13: the test-author writes the red cases.
